Name: Quails for Sharkles Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I received a request to revive [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21538?tab=description]CP- Quails for Sharkles[/url] and as the author had left permissions open for anyone who wanted to to pick it back up I went ahead and revived it!

This mod will add 2 new quails to Marnie's shop, common and valley. They live in coops and will lay small and large eggs. Use 5 small eggs to make tiny quail mayo or 2 large eggs to make normal sized quail mayo. There's also a config to rename the mayo to custard if you'd like. Eggs can also be hatched for more quails.

Enjoy!
